macros.name: ibarra
macros.doc: Command \ibarra selects the Ibarra Real Nova family and \ibarraSemiBold selects the SemiBold series.

macros.doc: To select oldstyle or lining figures locally, use \oldstylenums{...} or \liningnums{...}, respectively.
